name: How often should I have my deck inspected or maintained?
description: Annual professional inspections are recommended, with re-sealing or re-staining typically every 2-3 years, especially in areas like the East Bay.

mainEntity.name: How often should I have my deck inspected or maintained?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's recommended to have your deck professionally inspected at least once a year, ideally in the spring. Regular inspections can identify potential issues early, such as loose fasteners, wood rot, or compromised structural integrity, before they become significant problems. For decks in high-moisture areas or those exposed to harsh sun, like many in Berkeley or Oakland, more frequent spot checks by the homeowner are advisable, and re-sealing or re-staining every 2-3 years is common.
